exporter.note: the container records a package format and the section a data version; it carries no exporter build or revision. Those fields are null on purpose rather than guessed, and the game-side build receipt is bound with the labels, not here

limits: the prefab lane template and the integer flag-name tables are observed catalogs, not export bytes; both are hash-bound and leave-one-package-out checked
the two stock controls need their own package's prefab template for lanes; their tangents and all segment and node topology come directly from the export bytes
node OneWayIn/OneWayOut flag names are recomputed by the game at load and are never used
the exports carry no query, outcome or path, and this audit reads none
FILE identity is not memory attestation or strict no-mods
